official_definition: Up to twice per turn, you can exhaust a Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus you control. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes twice, and during this battle, the cost of every card in the opposing Hand/Removed Zone increases by +2.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grand Assault] or [Grand Assault: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grand Assault]", "give [Grand Assault]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
